| 0012 | Radar background: shaded per pixel in integer maths once per zoom change, cached in RAM strips | accepted |
| 0014 | Screens lay out in a safe area: the panel on rectangular boards, the inscribed square on the round one | accepted |
| 0016 | Promote select ledger items to GitHub issues: an item lives in one tracker, never both | accepted |
